title: Expense approvals queue
why: The first task that measures APPROPRIATENESS, not only conformance: a given queue of records with comparable fields is a worklist — rows, density, status at a glance — and the plausible wrong answer (a tile per record) is fully DS-conformant code that still fails the user. Exists so the decision layer (screen-specs/selection-rules.json, R1/R8) has an eval number: every component in the wrong answer is real, every prop legal, and only the representation is wrong.

forbidden.message: a Card per record — a queue is compared and worked through, which needs rows, not tiles (selection rules R1/R8): use <Table>
tiles are for destinations (hub), not for records to process (selection rules R9 vs R8)
